headline: Aprio Acquires Texas RIA Garner Asset Management
summary: Aprio has acquired Texas-based Garner Asset Management in its first standalone wealth management acquisition, expanding Aprio Wealth Management's assets under advisement.
why: Aprio provides advisory and wealth management services, participating in the ongoing consolidation trend across the registered investment advisor (RIA) sector.

impacts.name: Aprio
impacts.why: Expanding assets under advisement through an acquisition increases scale in the wealth management segment.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h
